summary: Quality review disproved two implementation assumptions: root-only listing does not satisfy caller-directed nested discovery, and a stable file length does not satisfy the accepted observed identity/metadata drift invariant. The next repair adds public-seam regression RED for nested-directory listing and equal-length in-flight range-read mutation, then changes only the existing handle-relative list/read implementation. Verification requires focused RED, minimal GREEN, the complete prepared-source suite, clean convergence, refreshed lookback and fresh quality review.
failed_obligations: list_prepared_source must enumerate immediate children of any authorized requested directory
ReadTextRange must return ChangedInput without text when observed file identity or metadata drifts
affected_assumptions: Root-only listing plus recursive search was sufficient for caller-directed discovery.
Equal file length before and after a range read was sufficient stability evidence.
changed_approach: Reuse the accepted held-root no-follow traversal and ObserveFile mechanisms instead of adding a new seam or capability.
next_check: Regression RED for both findings, focused GREEN, all PreparedSource tests, convergence, refreshed lookback and fresh quality review.
